# Prompt 27 — handoff

- **Status proposed:** READY_FOR_REVIEW. Never self-approved.
- **Repository base SHA / delivered SHA:** base `f862ff6f2db159181e42fa5f1180968d56fe9e50`; delivered reviewer candidate is uncommitted.
- **Canonical inputs and version/hash:** source manifest `dfa0429ded121b6f1d489ab2a8ea0f9767b48d54bb61062324207c6a99eee5d3`; Prompt 27 `55f7794f0a7d30e75f080540a95bebf2336faa4dc2c682a070900b7ede3e419f`; Prompt 25 acquisition manifest `40c9a08e759c38e885d7f07e261b51711e42e1321fb8a7cedc6463e3e796464f`; Prompt 26 scenario configuration `ab4ccb03b7b638c62f37c27111a2bd27cd156008d2b8b4e8bcad7c5ecb42d904`; AM-GOV-067 initialization profile `4affa81339e8473e176552da43bf56225db29c88668e413d2240cc4e512f2305`; source map `8ef3de3e1bcb846c405915fad33c03f1b38376d83e66ba6d8900681202da3c27`; conflict source `acce392bb35cfcf7ee1f24c9fc4c6025be4480335e46c6a4acc3912ad51bf65b`.
- **Implementation files changed and why:** domain adds production zone IDs, explicit-null quality fields and Save Snapshot v2 artifact pins; data-pipeline adds the deterministic production compiler; application adds artifact verification, IndexedDB recovery and the production composition root; web makes production the default route and isolates synthetic content behind `?testRoute=1`; UI accepts production-classified projections and renders verified direct GeoJSON; tests cover compiler, persistence, browser reload/recovery and procedure edges.
- **Contracts added/changed and downstream compatibility:** Save Snapshot v2 adds required production artifact refs while legacy v1 remains readable; release scenario entries add the pinned methodology reference; `MapArtifactManifest` adds `african_map_json_bundle` while legacy PMTiles remains valid; production zone IDs and explicit-null quality values are additive; UI classifications add production variants. Prompt 28 must consume these exact artifact hashes and may not replace their owners.
- **Test command + exit code + real output/log path:** `corepack pnpm run artifacts:verify`, `corepack pnpm run ci`, `corepack pnpm run test:e2e`, `corepack pnpm run test:production:e2e`, `corepack pnpm run build:production`, governance, schema and diff checks all have their actual results in `docs/build/logs/27-test.log`.
- **Negative tests and independent fixture ID:** production serializer rejects `TEST_ONLY`; corrupt current snapshot recovers the last valid snapshot; durable-write failure preserves visible/in-memory state through the shared atomic service; stale revision and concurrent same-campaign operations cannot double-commit; procedure steps reject before consultation and lead time; the final consent attempt rejects `KNOWN_COST_UNAFFORDABLE` without revision change. Production campaign ID/seed is fixed as `campaign_local_primary`; synthetic acceptance data remains isolated to `?testRoute=1`.
- **Not tested / reasons:** no cloud/account sync, deployment provider, hosted browser matrix or months 5–20 content is in Prompt 27 scope. No separate legal/regional review is claimed because AM-GOV-062 defines the procedures and actor positions as fictional game design under owner-only review.
- **Open decisions and scope exclusions:** competitive leaderboard remains disabled. The approved opening resources fund Commission submission, consultation and PSC review but not the final host-consent action; no resource-recovery rule was approved, so the runtime fails that step closed. Prompt 28 must either approve a recovery rule or preserve this ceiling during full-campaign calibration.
- **Evidence artifacts / verifier and owner sign-off:** `apps/web/public/production/artifact-hashes.json`, `docs/build/ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE.md`, `docs/build/logs/27-test.log`, and the visually inspected `output/web-game/prompt-27-final-map/shot-0.png`. AM-GOV-067 is owner-approved and committed; PB2-27 itself has no owner sign-off yet.
- **Next prerequisite and revalidation requirements:** an independent owner reproduction and reviewed commit are required before PB2-27 may become ACCEPTED or Prompt 28 may begin.
